# AI decision models (Jev)

TypeSafe AI's Jev System One model (launched 2026-09-15): typed, calibrated decisions in 70–500 ms. Official SDKs, games built on it, open/local alternatives, dev tooling, directories.

Stars checked 2026-09-23. Notes: [notes/ai-decisions.md](../notes/ai-decisions.md). Sync locally: `node scripts/sync.mjs --category ai-decisions`
